attacks.name: Lumikinetic Blast
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Stun|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Princess of Pyrotechnics
steps: |!wild| |!hit| |*Rapid Fire|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Princess of Pyrotechnics| attack without paying the |!power| cost. This additional attack must target the original defender and does not have the |*Rapid Fire| special rule.

superPowers.name: Fireworks
superPowers.body: When this character or another allied character within |!range| 2 is defending, during the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may spend up to 3 |!power| to use this superpower. For each |!power| spent, the defender may reroll 1 of its defense dice. A character can reroll dice with this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Wolverine!
superPowers.body: When this character is the target of an attack, if an allied |*James Logan Howlett| is within |!range| 2, this character may use this superpower. The allied |*James Logan Howlett| becomes the target of the attack regardless of |!range| and LOS.

superPowers.name: I Totally Meant to Do That!
superPowers.body: When this character rolls dice, after the effect is resolved, if it rolled at least 1 |!critical|, it gains 1 |!power| and drops all objective tokens it is holding.
